messages:
kira: dropped a prototype for Prompt Sets > Eval Runs — new behavior: if any selected run has quality < configured threshold (e.g., 60) the approval modal forces a short reason selection before allowing approve. Also supporting per-run override after batch approve. Link: https://figma.com/file/reason-flow
max: interesting. Goal is better audit trails, right? Microcopy thought: modal header 'Approve X runs' then inline: '2 runs are below your project's quality threshold; a reason is required for those.' Reason label should be short: 'Reason (required for low-quality runs)'.
jules: UX nits: keep default 'Approve selected' CTA but add secondary 'Approve and add note' for when reviewer wants to annotate. For per-run overrides after batch approve, show a compact row-level banner 'Overrode auto-block: Reason: ...' with an edit link.
rachel: Accessibility: reason selector must be reachable by keyboard and announced. Use aria-invalid when empty and required. If multiple low-quality runs, modal should allow one reason for all or individual reasons—prefer one reason for batch and an optional per-run edit screen.
a11y-bot: a11y recs: 1) set role="dialog" and focus trap into modal. 2) When modal opens announce 'Approve dialog opened. 2 runs below threshold, reason required.' via aria-live. 3) Ensure the reason select has aria-required and descriptive aria-describedby pointing to the threshold explanation. 4) If inline per-run banners appear after approve, announce 'Override recorded for run <id>' with polite aria-live.
kira: copy tweak: avoid jargon. Change 'quality threshold' to 'review threshold' in UI, keep internal name in settings. Modal explanatory copy: 'These runs are below the project's review threshold. Approving them requires a short reason to help audit and future reviewers.'
max: safety: if reviewer chooses 'Approve all anyway' require them to type a short freeform reason (min 8 chars) rather than picking a canned reason to avoid accidental approvals. Add character counter and clear examples in placeholder.
jules: visual: in roomy list show a tiny red dot on runs below threshold and include small score chip '54' with hidden text 'Quality score: 54'. When batch approved with overrides, show a subtle banner on each affected row: 'Approved with reason' and a link to view/edit reason. Make banner 14px and ensure contrast.
rachel: keyboard flow: open modal with Enter, Tab to reason select, choose via arrows, Tab to Approve, Press Enter. If freeform required, ensure screen reader reads the min char requirement. After approving, focus should move to toast 'Approved 3 runs. [Undo] [View reasons]' and ARIA announce.
a11y-bot: addendum: for the 'View reasons' panel, ensure it's accessible as a dialog with label 'Approval reasons' and keyboard-trap-free; provide CSV export of reasons. Also ensure RTL flip for banners and that the reason select options are localized strings.
kira: plan: I'll update prototype with: 'review threshold' wording, forced reason flow for low scores, require typed reason for override, per-run banners with edit links, accessible focus management and ARIA messages, and toast with 'View reasons'. Will post updated figma and a short dev a11y checklist by tomorrow. Thanks! :thumbsup:
